captures.label: TC-07.4A tags after the restart rebuilt it
captures.sql:
SELECT 'TC-07.4A tags after the restart rebuilt it' AS check_name,
       column_name, tag_name, tag_value
FROM TABLE(P7_POC.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES_ALL_COLUMNS('P7_POC.D_STAGE.CUSTOMER_360','table'))
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'PII'   
ORDER BY column_name
captures.expect_text:
/* EXPECT  STILL ZERO ROWS.
   The rebuild copied the tags of the untagged table it replaced, so the
   table is untagged again and the publish is refused again. Repeating
   the restart will never fix it.
   IF 2 ROWS APPEAR  =  COPY TAGS does not behave as documented, which is
   a finding in its own right. Record it and stop.                     */
captures.detail: 0 rows, as expected
